topics.title: Howard Stern's Wild Lieutenant Governor Campaign
topics.summary: During a convention, Howard Stern recruits county legislator Stan Dworkin as his lieutenant governor candidate; the campaign is marked by bizarre events including Tempest’s absence and discussions about shaving off Dworkin’s mustache. Rumors circulate of Dworkin meeting a married woman at the bar, with concerns raised about potential libertarian support for the candidacy.

topics.title: Stern's Libertarian Gambit
topics.summary: During a Libertarian Party convention in Albany, Howard Stern discusses bizarre encounters involving illicit activities and introduces potential running mates like Stan Dworkin and Fred the Elephant Boy, emphasizing their scandal-free backgrounds. He also recounts an awkward meeting with strangers requesting to watch private moments while highlighting concerns about delays due to logistical issues.

topics.title: Stern’s Convention Press Conference
topics.summary: During a press conference at an Italian-American convention hall, Howard Stern discusses his political ambitions for governor of New York, expresses frustration with the media and campaign delays, proposes giving Robin a portion of his potential salary, and repeatedly emphasizes his seriousness as a candidate. topics.title: Gambling Criticism and Convention Chaos
topics.summary: During a chaotic libertarian party convention, Howard Stern discusses the legalization of gambling in New York while criticizing Mario Cuomo’s perceived advantages. He expresses frustration over Cuomo's extensive media access and suggests equal time should be granted to all candidates amidst an overwhelming crowd seeking attention.

topics.title: Libertarian Convention Nomination Chaos
topics.summary: A chaotic libertarian convention unfolds with candidates nominating themselves, bizarre speeches about drug legalization and electric chairs, and general disarray. Several individuals withdraw from the race including a candidate advocating for marijuana legalization, leading to random speech selections and debates being abruptly canceled amidst confusion over the nomination process.

topics.title: Libertarian Convention Nomination Chaos
topics.summary: At a libertarian convention, candidates nominate each other amidst chaotic interruptions and bizarre speeches. Jim Ostrowski is nominated for governor of New York while questioning state policies, Howard Stern discusses drug use and prison reform with audience members including an angry police officer, and Kenneth Keith nominates Howard Stern to be the next governor.

topics.title: Stern Nomination Chaos at Libertarian Convention
topics.summary: At the libertarian convention, Howard Stern’s nomination for governor sparks immediate controversy as Joe Brennan criticizes his endorsement of Stan Dworkin and calls him unqualified. The crowd becomes increasingly chaotic with challenges to Stern's candidacy and a general questioning of his qualifications, escalating into heated arguments.

topics.title: Stern’s Convention Campaign Amidst Dissent
topics.summary: At a libertarian party convention, Howard Stern attempts to secure the gubernatorial nomination despite disagreements with candidate Joe Brennan over cut signs and accusations of inciting anger. He emphasizes his commitment to libertarian solutions alongside Stan Dworkin's joining the party, delivering an impassioned speech aimed at winning over skeptical delegates.

topics.title: Stern Announces Governor Candidacy
topics.summary: Howard Stern declared his candidacy for New York governor, criticizing James Ostrowski and advocating a libertarian platform focused on tax reductions and ending the war on drugs. He nominated Stan Dworkin as lieutenant governor to emphasize fiscal responsibility while dismissing concerns about campaign fundraising, leading to extended questioning and debate among candidates.

topics.title: Stern Declares Candidacy Amidst Convention Chaos
topics.summary: During a chaotic Libertarian Party convention marked by disputes over voting procedures and heated arguments, Howard Stern announced his intention to run for the party nomination. Attendees engaged in shouting matches while attempting a head count, with several candidates ultimately throwing their support behind Stern as he declared victory.

topics.title: Libertarian Convention Nomination Chaos
topics.summary: At the Libertarian Party convention, Howard Stern secures the nomination for governor amidst a chaotic roll-call vote and heated debate over his choice of running mate. Attendees express frustration with voting procedures, demand paper ballots, and ultimately celebrate Stern’s victory while questioning Stan Dworkin's suitability.”} 39 words”**

topics.title: Howard Stern Announces Lieutenant Governor Nomination
topics.summary: During a libertarian party convention, Howard Stern formally nominates Stan Dworkin as his lieutenant governor, outlining policy positions including support for the death penalty and addressing homelessness through private industry partnerships. He emphasizes individual responsibility and limited government intervention before discussing potential crime reduction strategies.

topics.title: Stern Campaigns for Governor with Stan Dworkin
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, Howard Stern campaigned for governor alongside Stan Dworkin, advocating for libertarian policies like tax cuts and marijuana legalization while criticizing the mainstream media's targeting of him. He emphasized appointing libertarians to his administration and promised minimal government intervention.
